Profile & Mindset

Behind the Vision

I’m Flebin Francis, currently pursuing an MA in European Business Management, specialising in Sustainability and Marketing. I hold a Bachelor of Commerce in Finance and Computer Applications, complemented by professional experience in the banking sector.

With a background in finance, technology, and banking, I have developed a strong interest in sustainable business practices, strategic marketing, and international business management. I aspire to contribute to innovative business strategies that balance organisational growth with environmental and social responsibility.

Case Studies

Selected case studies.

Corporate Accounting Project, 8 pages. Scroll to read.
Read the summary

Nova Ltd. is a trading company. This project values closing inventory with the FIFO method, then calculates cost of goods sold, profit and the statement of cash flows (indirect method) for the year ended 31 December 2019.

  • Closing inventory: CU 27,500 (250 units at CU 110)
  • Cost of goods sold: CU 101,500; gross profit: CU 69,500
  • Net profit: CU 17,500
  • Net cash from operating activities: CU 36,000; closing cash: CU 46,000
  • The closing balance sheet balances at CU 168,500.
Future Park Project Report, 16 pages. Scroll to read.
Read the summary

Future Park is a concept for an open civic innovation hub in Ludwigsfelde, Germany, that connects nature and technology to support sustainable mobility, a circular economy and digital change. It was written for the module Strategic Foresight and Scenario Analysis as a team project of five students, supervised by Prof. Dr. Dana Mietzner and Mr. Markus Lahr.

  • Method: design thinking, creativity and scenario techniques, and co-creation
  • Ideas: Solar Repair Pop-up, Smart Tool Library, Micro Factory Lab, AI Garden, Rain Garden, Night Market and Skills Exchange, Community Data Studio
  • Goals: less car use and waste, better skills and networking, and a model for other towns
  • Fits SDG 11, 9 and 13 and the European Green Deal
